name: Fractal Geometry Lab — 2D
desc: Explore nineteen two-dimensional fractal families including Sierpinski, Koch, Hilbert, dragon curves, Barnsley fern, Mandelbrot and Julia sets. Zoom, pan, change iterations, gradient colors and glow, and record or export your experiments.
shortDesc: Explore 19 fractal families, deep zoom, glowing gradients, animated iterations and video capture.
learningObjectives: Investigate recursive self-similarity in two-dimensional fractals
Compare iteration depth and geometric complexity
Explore complex quadratic iteration and zoom on the Mandelbrot and Julia sets
Compare color gradients and identify where visual effects do not change the mathematics
modelAssumptions: Finite iteration approximations are not identical to infinite limit fractals
Similarity dimensions are reported only when assumptions justify them
Rendering may simplify subpixel elements for performance
Complex-plane escape sets are computed with finite precision and iteration budgets
